notes.title: Buttplug Update in Public Beta
notes.notes:
Hey everybody!

We’ve just released an update to the public beta we believe will eliminate a lot (if not all) of the connection headache that some of you have been experiencing. If you’ve been having trouble connecting your toy to ViRo Playspace, please do give it a try and let us know how it works for you.

A little history
In the early days of ViRo Playspace, qdot was kind enough to help us develop a specialized version of Buttplug built directly into ViRo. (We called it, predictably, the Buttplugin.) We wanted to make the experience as seamless as possible for our users, and as such, didn’t want anyone to have to download something separate if we could help it.

The times are a-changin’
It was a great solution back then, but as is often the case, environments change, and solutions must adapt. We started getting complaints about toys having difficulty connecting - Kiiroo users in particular seemed to bear the brunt of these frustrations. We assumed it was the same connectivity issues that we’d dealt with in the studio from time to time, and offered the solutions that usually fixed things for us. And it worked for some of you. But for others, the problem persisted.

Aha!
When you told us your toys were having no problems connecting to Intiface Central? That was our lightbulb moment. We did some digging, and it became clear. Now that Intiface Central has grown into the expected standard for haptic toy connection - meaning most Buttplug users have it installed already - our built-in Buttplug was now creating rather than eliminating confusion.

A Buttplug traffic jam, if you will.

So, if you've been one of the ones having difficulty connecting your toys, thank you for your patience and feedback as we've  worked through this issue, and let us know how the update works for you. And even if your toy has been connecting just fine, we'd still love your feedback!

notes.title: Massive ViRo Playspace Update
notes.notes:
We have some big announcements!

We are excited to announce that our latest Dream experience titled “Ela’s Dreamscape” will be available for purchase here on Steam in one week!

Additionally, we are officially releasing our new and improved build of ViRo Playspace on Steam today and we’re making it easier than ever to access ViRo Dream Experiences. All the Dream Experiences have been updated and repackaged as Steam DLC because a lot of people were having trouble getting them using Steam's microtransaction overlay.  

We’ve done a massive overhaul and improved all of the Dream Experiences, so the ones you already own should have a pretty nice makeover. They won’t show up as DLC that you own on Steam yet, but they will still be available in your account. 

Going forward, we are ending support for the standalone version of ViRo Playspace and moving it exclusively to the Steam platform. This move will give us more bandwidth to focus on content creation and develop the various social features for the platform. Part of our migration to Steam is stepping away from in-game currency. Our token system was originally implemented for online features that are still in development, and we believe that switching to simple DLC items instead of in-game currency will make more sense and be easier for everyone.

We will happily help you migrate any purchased tokens still on your account to DLC content.  Just fill out the form on this page and we’ll take care of it. It’s a manual process on our end so it may take a day or two.

Finally, if you’ve only ever used our Standalone app and are new to using ViRo Playspace on Steam, fear not! All of the content you own is still accessible on your account can easily be transferred over by linking your account to the Steam version of the app which you can do as soon as you launch it.
